params.prompt:
One continuous 8-second VERTICAL 9:16 smartphone front-camera selfie talking-head video of the adult man in the IMAGE reference. This is his own authorized avatar. Use the IMAGE for his exact facial identity, proportions, skin tone, transparent glasses, hair, stubble and navy open-collar shirt ONLY. Replace the original study, seated desk composition and camera viewpoint completely: he is standing beside a living-room window at home, neutral wall, a modest bookshelf, an ordinary sofa in the background, softly lit by indirect daylight. The setting is a generated visual test, no claim of a real visit.

The camera is the phone he is recording himself with, held at comfortable arm's length slightly above eye level. We see through its front camera, not an external camera filming a phone. Close head-and-upper-chest framing, complete top of head visible with modest headroom. His right upper arm extends subtly toward the recording phone outside frame. No visible phone, no hand to ear, no tripod framing. Very small irregular handheld drift linked to the supporting arm, roughly stable framing, no dramatic shake, no walking, no cinematic push-in. Natural candid phone-camera detail and depth of field, ordinary daylight, natural skin texture, no beauty filter or studio lighting.

First muted VIDEO reference supplies relaxed facial settling, ordinary blinking, small asymmetric head-angle adjustments and comfortable stillness. Second muted VIDEO reference supplies clear connected articulation and concise emphasis which relaxes again. These are behavior references of this same owner only: do not copy their clothing, microphone, headphones, room, off-screen interview gaze, speech or mouth timing. Keep his face unmistakably the IMAGE identity. Look toward the phone lens as if explaining something calmly to one friend. Relaxed brows, no sales grin, brief natural look-away at most, no rhythmic nodding. The phone-holding arm remains steady; do not imitate the studio clip's two-handed table gestures. Free hand can make one small unforced motion below shoulder level, but the main performance is face and voice.

Speak exactly the supplied 7.5-second AUDIO, preserving the original speaker identity, words, connected syllables, pace and pauses: "A buyer is sitting across the table from a woman who has run the same business for twenty five years. It makes money." Audio starts at the beginning of the clip. Finish the final word at its original time, then let lips and expression settle through the final silence to 8 seconds. No invented words or trailing mouth movement, no music or added ambience. No titles, subtitles, logos, watermark, cuts, extra people or changing appearance.
